name: html-vertical-flex-column-becomes-group
description: A flex container with flex-direction:column is a vertical stack, so it converts to a vertical core/group (layout type flex, orientation vertical) rather than a horizontal core/columns. This is the regression guard for layout_direction_misrecognition :: columns_from_vertical_flex — a hero stack (eyebrow, title, subhead, buttons) must render stacked, not side-by-side.

source_reference.notes: Keys solely off the CSS flex-direction:column value (never class/fixture names). ColumnsPattern declines vertical flex so the host routes to core/group, and layoutAttribute emits an explicit orientation:vertical so the flex group stacks instead of defaulting to a horizontal Row.

legacy_comparison.reason: Covers current PHP transformer flex-direction-aware layout behavior; no downstream legacy comparison.
